stories.headline: Health benefits platform Thatch reaches $1B valuation as healthcare costs surge
stories.dek: Thatch helps employers keep healthcare costs manageable by offering an individual plan marketplace through an Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangement — a model that lets companies fund employees' own individual insurance plans instead of enrolling everyone in one company-wide plan.
